exposure: maternal plasma protein biomarkers (antithrombin-III, plasminogen activator inhibitor-I, soluble vascular endothelial growth factor receptor-II, soluble Tie-II)
cohort: Pregnant women with placenta previa suspicious of PAS, between 28 and 42 weeks of gestation, were included from a tertiary hospital.
finding: A combination of four maternal serum biomarkers with a history of cesarean delivery showed the most promising performance for prenatal screening of PAS (77% sensitivity, 89% specificity, and an AUC of 0.87).
mod_finding: A history of cesarean delivery, as a mode of birth, was an important factor combined with biomarkers to create the best screening model for PAS.
